profile.description: PZTestKit (016dce05) + the staged NutritionRevamp copy (release/plan11-x39, 513778e8) + TKX_StudyFoods, fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, gclog on - x391f, Plan 11b Task 2 confirmatory session.

meta.staging: python tools/release_pack.py stage mod/NutritionRevamp --out release/plan11-x39 at 513778e8 (Plan 11b Task 2); no instrument added
meta.seams_note: Every ghost run, in every loaded arm, runs the writer dry (W.dry) and skips the store step for ghost names (S.skip = H0.isGhost), set inside H0.work, which every scheduler calls (Plan 11a ruling 15).
meta.batching_note: budget15 times its ghost runs in one batch a tick; mod and spread keep one batch open across a drain's contiguous ghost runs and close it at a real player's run, a task or the drain's end (H0.modRun, H0.modWrap): at most one extra swap and two clock reads per real player a tick against mod.
meta.cost_note: Every server reading is cost, not behaviour: the ghosts run copies of the real records against the two real IsoPlayers. The two real players stay on the mod's own drain.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: a frame's busy is a 1 ms reading; every per-run cost is a total over many runs divided by their count.

The spread arms take k from ARM_K per tag; SMOKE checks sched.arm's echoed k.
Subjects mod1, spr1a, spr15a; reference mod1; pairs spr1a/mod1, spr15a/mod1.
MULT: the M reply parsed into mult and eff; time.snapshot at S0 and before each arm's load recorded as mult (trueMult) and eff (mult); never a bare time.multiplier (its handler would set 1).
CARRIER (the seam check on the fixed carrier) added; x391d's SEAM void rule kept.
HARNESS_COMMIT 016dce05 recorded and HARNESS_MARKERS asserted before the boot; git log 513778e8..HEAD -- mod/ must be empty.
The server-log greps and the mod-error filter also exclude PROBE_RX, the driver's own probe names.
A SETTLE_S wait between the load and ghost.stats reset, in every loaded arm alike (as x391d).
